meta.story_ref: Story.md: team offsite around the MONO Music Conference, San Francisco, 12 to 15 Nov 2026 (fictional dates for the show and dinner).

assumptions: Policy has only the three assignment rules. Everything else the agent does (FX tolerance, duplicate matching, unusual-amount flag, linked-claims flag) is our assumption and is marked in policy.agent_settings.
External guests (ext_ravi, ext_guest1, ext_speaker1...) appear only in attendee lists. They are not people in the system.
Exchange rates are fixtures, not real quotes. EUR to USD is 1.0800 and SEK to USD is 0.1052 on 12 Nov 2026.
The company is named Spotify in Story.md but Personas.md describes a small-to-midsize software company. Only meta.company.name needs to change.
Payout is out of scope. 'approved' means approved, not paid.
Noa does not attend the concert. Kwame bought 9 tickets for the team of 9, so Noa is not approving her own spend.
Merchant names are fictional except the MONO Music Conference and the Red Hot Chili Peppers, which come from Story.md.

There are three policies, the ones in the assignment. Two readings are ours and sit on the rules themselves: the $1,000 Finance rule is read per employee over a rolling 7 days (window_days), and the manager can approve up to $100 without a receipt on a card statement (exception_ceiling_usd). How long a waiting claim waits before it returns to the manager's queue is in policy.agent_settings.wait_days.
